Option B: Redwood Boardroom — single large space, less breakout flexibility.

- Please complete the visitor_badging_form.pdf for each attendee. We can fast-track badging if we receive headshots by Oct 11.

NDA:

Network / AV:
- Guest Wi‑Fi is available; for hands-on lab we recommend bringing a small hub and we’ll provision a VLAN for the session.
- AV: 2x HDMI + slack for screen-sharing; we’ll have an AV tech on-site to assist.

Catering:
- We can provide boxed lunches (VEG/MEAT/GLUTEN-FREE options). If you want outside caterer please share dietary needs by Oct 8.

Next steps (if this works):
1) I’ll route a calendar invite for Oct 18 9:30–13:00 PDT and provision badges once I get the completed forms.
2) I’ll also loop Ben (Ops) and Aditya (Solutions Eng) to confirm room and network setup.

If helpful, I can do a 15-min pre-visit logistics call next week.
